feature.name: Echo Strategy Coach
feature.techContext: Echo uses AI gateway (LangChain + configurable provider via core/config) - NOT hardcoded to Anthropic. Tools use @tool decorator from langchain.tools.

stories.title: Create Strategy model
acceptanceCriteria: Strategy model exists with fields: goals, platforms, posts_per_week, schedule, pillars, voice, recommendations
OneToOneField to User with related_name='strategy'
Migration created and applied
errorHandling: Model allows all fields to be blank/empty for incremental building
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from core.content_engine.models import Strategy; print('Strategy model exists')"
docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from core.content_engine.models import Strategy; s = Strategy._meta.get_fields(); print([f.name for f in s])" | grep -q 'goals'
docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from core.content_engine.models import Strategy; s = Strategy._meta.get_fields(); print([f.name for f in s])" | grep -q 'platforms'
validation: All fields optional except user FK

stories.title: Create Strategy API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/content-engine/strategy/ returns user's strategy (creates if not exists)
PUT /api/v1/content-engine/strategy/ updates strategy (partial updates allowed)
Response includes all strategy fields
errorHandling: Partial updates don't clear other fields
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from core.content_engine.serializers import StrategySerializer; print('StrategySerializer exists')"
validation: platforms must be valid: linkedin, twitter, youtube
stories.scale: Single object per user, no pagination needed

stories.title: Create strategy tool for Echo
acceptanceCriteria: strategy tool added to ECHO_TOOLS list
Called with no args returns current strategy
Called with args updates strategy (partial updates)
Tool uses state['user_id'] for user context
errorHandling: Returns error dict if user not authenticated
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from services.agents.echo.tools import ECHO_TOOLS; print([t.name for t in ECHO_TOOLS])" | grep -q 'strategy'

stories.title: Update Echo system prompt for coach personality
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt instructs Echo to be a proactive coach
Includes guidance on giving opinions and recommendations
Includes examples of good vs bad responses
References strategy tool usage

stories.title: Pre-inject strategy into Echo context on connect
acceptanceCriteria: When Echo agent initializes, load user's strategy from DB
Inject strategy summary into system context/state
If no strategy exists, context indicates new user
errorHandling: If strategy load fails, continue without it (graceful degradation)
stories.scale: One DB query on agent init

stories.title: Update empty state with goal examples
acceptanceCriteria: Empty state shows 'What are your goals?' heading
Shows 4-5 clickable example pills below the heading
Clicking example sends it as message to Echo
Examples include: 'Post to LinkedIn 3x/week', 'Grow my Twitter audience', 'Build thought leadership'
errorHandling: Pills disabled while disconnected or typing
testSteps: npx playwright test frontend/tests/e2e/echo-empty-state.spec.ts || echo 'E2E test pending'
stories.a11y: Example pills are buttons with descriptive text
stories.mobile: Pills wrap to multiple lines on small screens

stories.title: Create useStrategy hook and strategy service
acceptanceCriteria: Strategy TypeScript interface added to types
strategy.ts service with getStrategy() and updateStrategy() functions
useStrategy hook that fetches and caches user's strategy
Hook returns { strategy, isLoading, error, refetch }
errorHandling: Returns null strategy if API fails (not authenticated or no strategy)
stories.loadingState: Hook returns isLoading: true while fetching

stories.title: Show strategy summary for returning users
acceptanceCriteria: If user has strategy, show summary instead of goal examples
Summary displays: platforms, cadence (Xx/week), pillars
Shows 'Continue where I left off' button
Clicking button sends contextual message to Echo
errorHandling: If strategy fetch fails, fall back to goal examples
testSteps: npx playwright test frontend/e2e/echo-strategy-summary.spec.ts || echo 'E2E test pending'
stories.a11y: Strategy summary is readable by screen readers

stories.title: Remove old Echo tools
acceptanceCriteria: generate_hooks function and schema removed
expand_to_post function and schema removed
get_content_pillars function and schema removed
ECHO_TOOLS list only contains: save_idea, strategy
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py shell -c "from services.agents.echo.tools import ECHO_TOOLS; names = [t.name for t in ECHO_TOOLS]; assert 'save_idea' in names; assert 'strategy' in names; assert len(names) == 2; print('OK')"

stories.title: Remove ContentGoal model and API
acceptanceCriteria: ContentGoal model removed from models.py
ContentGoal serializers removed from serializers.py
ContentGoalViewSet removed from views.py
goals URL registration removed from urls.py
Migration created to drop content goal table
testSteps: docker compose exec -T web python manage.py migrate --check
stories.notes: ContentGoal was added earlier in this session - this removes it

stories.title: Remove goals frontend code
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useGoals.ts deleted
frontend/src/services/contentEngine/goals.ts deleted
GoalStatus, GoalType, ContentGoal types removed from contentEngine.ts
useActiveGoals import and usage removed from EchoConversation.tsx
